description: This file defines a logging utility class named Log for handling different types of log messages (info, warning, error, documentation issues) with formatting for different OS environments. It includes methods for printing, recording, and dumping log messages, along with configuring verbosity and message types.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A logging utility class enabling structured logging of informational, warning, error, and documentation issues with configurable verbosity and message formatting.

methods.name: __init__(self, name, verbose = False, warnings = True, doc_issues = False)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Log object with a name and optional verbosity/warning/document issue display flags; sets up message prefixes based on OS.

methods.name: __Print(self, text, file="")
methods.description: Internal method to print a formatted message to stdout, optionally with a file prefix.

methods.name: Info(self, text, file="")
methods.description: Logs an informational message if verbosity is enabled.

methods.name: DocIssue(self, text, file="")
methods.description: Logs a documentation issue message if such issues are configured to be shown.

methods.name: Warn(self, text, file="")
methods.description: Logs a warning message if warnings are enabled.

methods.name: WarnLine(self, obj, text, file="")
methods.description: Logs a warning with additional context from a provided object, indicating the location in a source file.

methods.name: Print(self, text, file="")
methods.description: Prints a general message unrelated to the specific log levels.

methods.name: Dump(self)
methods.description: Outputs all accumulated messages (errors, warnings, infos) to stdout.

methods.name: Header(self, text)
methods.description: Marks the start of processing a specific file, setting internal state for the filename.

methods.name: Ellipsis(self,text, front=True)
methods.description: Truncates a long text to fit within 32 characters, adding ellipsis accordingly, either from the front or the end.

methods.name: Success(self, text)
methods.description: Prints a success message indicating completion.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, name, verbose = False, warnings = True, doc_issues = False):$/
ctags.signature: (self, name, verbose = False, warnings = True, doc_issues = False)
